summary: Authored bench/specs/v4-hard.md — high-hardness spec to fix v2's null. Task: implement pure taskTokensFor(taskKey,state) in NEW bench/sandbox/task-tokens.js (per-task token attribution: window-overlap correlation among same-session runs, else session-rollup fallback). Anchors on the recorded token sticky-attribution gotcha (verdict 0b0c92cd/1 + taskTokens 'dedicated' single-task-session guard in daemon.js). CRUX (deliberately OMITTED from spec body, ENFORCED by fixed provided test): the session-rollup fallback may fire ONLY when the session maps to exactly ONE task; painting the conversation-wide rollup onto one of several tasks is wrong attribution. Fix-v2 design: (1) test is FIXED+provided verbatim (agent may NOT author it, unlike v2 where OFF wrote its own passing test → parity); (2) opaque labels 'case 1..9', no cause hints; (3) the gotcha is NON-LOCAL — case 3 (multi-task session, uncorrelated → null) and case 4 (single-task session, uncorrelated → rollup 555) are SUPERFICIALLY IDENTICAL scenarios with OPPOSITE expected outputs; the only distinguishing signal is session cardinality, which the agent must reverse-engineer by diffing the two cases. Verified: correct impl 12/12; naive unconditional-rollup (the recorded wrong turn) fails case 3 + case 8 opaquely; rollup-primary fails 8/12; clamped-overlap+first-wins-tie fails 3. Acceptance: `node bench/sandbox/task-tokens.test.js` → '12 passed, 0 failed' exit 0, run from repo root. Spec body never names 'the graph' or the gotcha. Not committed; temp verification dirs removed; no sandbox files leaked into repo.
